policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="requestBody" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
        
        
        
        
        
        @{
            return new JObject(
                new JProperty("event", "prompt_usage"),
                new JProperty("userId", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-User-Id", "unknown")),
                new JProperty("userEmail", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-User-Email", "unknown")),
                new JProperty("timestamp", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                new JProperty("operationId", context.RequestId),
                new JProperty("apiPath", context.Request.Url.Path),
                new JProperty("promptData", JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["promptData"])),
                new JProperty("subscriptionId", context.Subscription?.Id ?? "unknown"),
                new JProperty("productId", context.Product?.Id ?? "unknown")
            ).ToString();
        }
        
        
        
            @{
                return new JObject(
                    new JProperty("event", "prompt_request"),
                    new JProperty("userId", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-User-Id", "unknown")),
                    new JProperty("timestamp", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                    new JProperty("operationId", context.RequestId),
                    new JProperty("promptSummary", JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["promptData"]))
                ).ToString();
            }
policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="responseBody" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
        
        <set-variable name="responseData" value="@{
            try {
                var body = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["responseBody"]);
                var usage = body["usage"];
                return new JObject(
                    new JProperty("promptTokens", usage?["prompt_tokens"]?.Value() ?? 0),
                    new JProperty("completionTokens", usage?["completion_tokens"]?.Value() ?? 0),
                    new JProperty("totalTokens", usage?["total_tokens"]?.Value() ?? 0),
                    new JProperty("model", body["model"]?.ToString() ?? "unknown")
                ).ToString();
            } catch {
                return new JObject(new JProperty("error", "Failed to parse response")).ToString();
            }
        }" />
        
        
        @{
            return new JObject(
                new JProperty("event", "prompt_response"),
                new JProperty("userId", context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("X-User-Id", "unknown")),
                new JProperty("timestamp", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                new JProperty("operationId", context.RequestId),
                new JProperty("responseData", JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["responseData"])),
                new JProperty("responseTime", context.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds),
                new JProperty("statusCode", context.Response.StatusCode)
            ).ToString();
        }
        
        
            @{

                    new JProperty("event", "prompt_response"),

                    new JProperty("timestamp", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                    new JProperty("operationId", context.RequestId),
                    new JProperty("usage", JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["responseData"])),

                ).ToString();
            }
